items.stem: Why prefer semantic HTML elements over generic divs?

options.text: They convey meaning and improve accessibility and structure
options.rationale: Correct: semantic elements aid assistive technology and document clarity.

options.rationale: Performance is not the primary reason; meaning and accessibility are.

options.text: They remove the need for any CSS
They are required for JavaScript to run
options.rationale: JavaScript does not require semantic markup.

items.stem: What does a mobile-first responsive approach mean?

options.text: Base styles target small screens, with media queries adding larger-screen rules
options.rationale: Correct: mobile-first builds up from small screens using min-width queries.

options.text: The site only works on phones
Desktop styles are written first, then overridden
options.rationale: That is desktop-first, the opposite approach.

options.text: JavaScript detects the device and swaps pages
options.rationale: Responsive design uses CSS, not page swapping.

items.explanation: Correct: mobile-first builds up from small screens using min-width queries.
